stories.title: The next Shohei Ohtani? Not so fast! Why we haven't seen more two-way stars in MLB
stories.summary: Ohtani was supposed to be a trailblazer. Instead, his unprecedented success has reinforced just how difficult what he's doing really is.

stories.title: Sanchez over Miz for NL Cy Young? Schlittler for Cy ... and MVP? Latest on awards races
stories.summary: Last chance for the candidates to make their case for the league's biggest postseason awards.

stories.title: DC Belichick resigns as UNC investigation finds disregard for conduct
stories.summary: North Carolina DC Steve Belichick has resigned as the university's probe into the football program's culture and climate found "isolated" disregard for standards of conduct.

stories.title: Sarkisian: Mishandled ESPN interview, knows Manning owns his mistake
stories.summary: Texas coach Steve Sarkisian says he should have better handled his postgame interview after the win over Ohio State and acknowledged the testy exchange led to the creation of fake videos and an apology from star quarterback Arch Manning.

stories.title: Pats RB Henderson declares self 'ready to go' after missing Week 1
stories.summary: Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson said Thursday he's "ready to go" for Sunday's game against the Steelers after missing New England's opener with an ankle injury.
